properties.name: Application
properties.description: Returns an Application object that represents the Microsoft Word application. Read-only.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which the specified object was created. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns an Object that represents the parent object of the specified Frames object.

properties.name: Count
properties.description: Returns a Long that represents the number of frames in the collection. Read-only.

methods.name: Item
methods.description: Returns an individual Frames object in a collection.

parameters.name: Index
parameters.description: The individual object to be returned.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Returns a Frame object that represents a new frame added to a range, selection, or document.

parameters.name: Range
parameters.description: The range that you want the frame to surround.
